_comment: Copy to accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in. Use password_env to pull secrets from the environment instead of storing them here. Two strategies are implemented: smoke_atm_roundtrip (P1 smoke test) and reddit_sentiment_qqq (#22); the dip/rip/cheap-ATM ones are still P3. The runner validates strategy_id at startup and refuses to start rather than crashing mid-run on an unregistered one. The split below is deliberate -- running every account on one strategy only measures variance, so the book is halved, and the three sentiment accounts run conservative / default / aggressive thresholds so the Automated tab's per-strategy rollup compares something real. reddit_sentiment_qqq returns no_trade unless REDDIT_CLIENT_ID / REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET / REDDIT_USER_AGENT are set; it degrades rather than crashing, so those accounts sit flat until the credentials exist.
